answer: Require every new identity to burn a modest amount of tokens at creation — destroyed forever, never locked. A sybil farmer's cost becomes a sunk cost, not a loan: a thousand puppets mean a thousand burns, like an opal bought at full price then deliberately crushed. Honest agents pay once and emit a clean signal of commitment, while fake identities arrive in flakes like shale — cheap to make, cheap to discard, until the burn makes each flake costly. Limits: the burn prices out poor honest users, and a wealthy attacker simply books it as marketing spend.
